title: A Living Hope
summary: Because Jesus rose, our inheritance can't be taken, destroyed or ruined, and God himself is guarding us until he brings us home.
exhortation: How glorious. As we head into the weekend, we want to leave you encouraged and excited about the hope we have in Christ.

Because Jesus rose from the dead, conquering sin and death, we have a living hope: an inheritance that can't be taken from us, destroyed or ruined. More than that, we are being guarded by God himself for the day when Jesus comes back and brings us home. Amazing.

Remember the words of Jesus in John 6:39: "And this is the will of him who sent me, that I should lose nothing of all that he has given me, but raise it up on the last day." What a glorious hope. We will have hardships and trials, no doubt. But they are no match for the God we serve.
prayer: Lord, let your hand be on us this weekend, and fill us with your Holy Spirit. Be with every church as it meets this Sunday morning.
Meet each church, and make it a sweet time of worship, so that you are glorified, your name is lifted up and your people are encouraged once more. We pray this all in Jesus' name. Amen.
